changes.summary: Continuity-only Project Memory event merged only after exact-final-head Test, NEXUS Build Verification, and NEXUS Cloud Fallback succeeded, mergeability was true, unresolved review threads were zero, and base remained exact current main.

continuity.policy: Repository evidence remains authoritative for transient state. Stale canonical STATE must remain fail-closed until deterministic canonical-path/schema/freshness validation and exact-main binding are implemented and verified.

lessons: A continuity event may merge only while its recorded base remains exact current main; green candidate CI alone does not authorize a stale-base merge.
Post-merge continuity evidence must record the actual GitHub merge result SHA rather than infer it from the candidate head.
